VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal launches its affordable a01+ AR glasses for $299, featuring a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design, making big-screen experiences more accessible.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces the return of Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, reviving the 2024 version for Meta Quest and PC VR later this month.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has released detailed technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing developer opportunities.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve has launched a new store page for its upcoming Steam Frame headset, signaling a potential release date nearing for the long-awaited device.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack has reiterated his $1 million guarantee to help commercialize VR ports of id Software’s classic games, urging Microsoft to take action.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game, is now available for free on Meta Quest, featuring hand tracking support.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the theft of trade secrets to advance its AI hardware projects.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.6 for government-approved organizations following regulatory approval, marking a significant update in its AI model offerings.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature that labels ads created or edited with AI, enhancing transparency for users across its platforms.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program that pays customers to host AI data center compute units in their homes, expanding its energy services.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled a controversial Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts after facing backlash.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: OpenAI’s AGI chief Fidji Simo is stepping down to a part-time advisory role due to health issues, following a medical leave.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire Hall of Famer John Riggins' No. 44, honoring his legacy over 40 years after his iconic Super Bowl run.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases like dementia compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri will enter the Colts' Ring of Honor during a ceremony on October 18, following his upcoming induction into the Hall of Fame.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Former Rams star Aaron Donald has been spotted working out at the team's facility, hinting at a possible unretirement.

NFL.title: Daniel Jones is "cleared to do everything" and "feeling good"
NFL.summary: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones has been cleared for all activities and is optimistic about his performance during the upcoming training camp.
